Question: what are the claim statuses and how does it move between them?

A Summit Insurance claim moves through these statuses.

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Submitted
    Submitted --> UnderReview: adjuster assigned
    UnderReview --> PendingInfo: documents missing
    PendingInfo --> UnderReview: documents uploaded
    UnderReview --> Approved
    UnderReview --> Denied
    Approved --> Paid: payment sent
    Denied --> Appealed
    Appealed --> UnderReview
    Paid --> [*]
```

Missing documents park a claim in Pending Info [1]; a denial is not final because an appeal sends it back to review [2].

Question: What stages does my application go through?

Your Northstar Staffing application can be in these stages.

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Applied
    Applied --> Screened: recruiter screen
    Applied --> Rejected
    Screened --> Submitted: sent to client
    Submitted --> Interviewing
    Interviewing --> Offered
    Interviewing --> Rejected
    Offered --> Placed: offer accepted
    Placed --> [*]
    Rejected --> [*]
```

Rejection can happen at the recruiter screen or after the client interview [1][2]; accepting an offer is what makes you Placed [2].

Question: draw the permit status workflow

Riverton building permit statuses:

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Received
    Received --> Returned: incomplete
    Received --> PlanReview: complete
    PlanReview --> CorrectionsRequired
    CorrectionsRequired --> PlanReview: resubmitted
    PlanReview --> Approved
    Approved --> Issued: fees paid
    Issued --> [*]
    Returned --> [*]
```

- Completeness is checked before plan review starts [1].
- Corrections loop back to plan review until approved, and the permit is issued only after fees are paid [2].

Question: Can you show the grant application statuses?

Evergreen grant applications move through these statuses.

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Draft
    Draft --> Submitted: before deadline
    Submitted --> Declined: ineligible
    Submitted --> CommitteeReview: eligible
    CommitteeReview --> Awarded
    CommitteeReview --> Declined
    Awarded --> Active
    Active --> Closed: final report accepted
    Closed --> [*]

```

An application can be declined at the eligibility screen or by the committee [1][2]; a grant only closes when the final report is accepted [2].

Question: laptop request statuses?

An Acme IT hardware request goes through these statuses.

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> PendingApproval
    PendingApproval --> Rejected: manager rejects
    PendingApproval --> Ordered: manager approves

```

Your manager approval is the first gate [1]; the request closes only after you confirm receipt [2].

Question: What are the stages of a maintenance ticket?

Parkview maintenance tickets use these stages.

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> New
    New --> Scheduled: triaged with visit date
    New --> InProgress: emergency
    Scheduled --> InProgress: visit
    InProgress --> OnHold: parts needed
    OnHold --> InProgress: parts arrive
    InProgress --> Resolved
    Resolved --> Reopened: within 7 days
    Reopened --> Scheduled
    Resolved --> [*]
```

Emergencies skip scheduling [1], and you can reopen a resolved ticket within 7 days [2].

Question: show print order statuses as a state diagram

InkWell print orders move through these states.

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
```
